title: Purpose before technology
text: We start with the problems worth solving and the impact we want to create. Technology is a means to achieve our purpose, not an end in itself.

title: Evidence over assumptions
text: We question assumptions, investigate uncertainty, and learn from reality. We use evidence to make better decisions and refine our approach as our understanding grows.

title: Progress through execution
text: Ideas create value when put into practice. We prioritize meaningful progress, act decisively, and learn by building. We favor speed without sacrificing the rigor that matters.

title: Simplicity by design
text: We build only the structure we need. We avoid unnecessary complexity, formalize as requirements emerge, and favor solutions that can evolve as Rh45 grows.

title: Autonomy with accountability
text: We design for independent action while maintaining responsibility for outcomes. We believe intelligent systems and organizations should be capable of adapting to changing conditions without losing sight of their purpose.
